category: Usenet provider (Aviteo GmbH, Germany) - trial offer

free_tier.stated: "You can try out Usenet risk-free for 14 days with free data volume." The trial page prices the Rookie+ package at "0 € During the trial with free download volume" and "30 GB Monthly highspeed data volume", then "7.95 € per month" after the trial.
free_tier.notes: The trial page prints no separate byte figure for the trial; 30 GB is the Rookie+ package volume the trial runs on. Whether the trial carries exactly that volume is inferred from the page layout, not from a second sentence.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap is published. The unit of retrieval is a Usenet article, roughly 750 KB by convention, so 30 GB is about 40,000 article fetches.

retention.stated: "More than 18 years retention of data (6,600+ days)" in the package feature list on the home page.

egress.terms: No separate traffic price is published; the trial is metered by downloaded volume and the plan list prices volume per month after it. The provider does not state an overage rate for the trial.

interface_detail: NNTP over SSL. The vendor publishes no API. The schema has no nntp token, so the array says unknown; the protocol is not in doubt.
tooling: any NNTP client (SABnzbd, NZBGet, nzbget CLI); the package bundles a VPN, not a downloader
chaining: A one-off 30 GB that must be spent inside 14 days on the largest remaining object, then cancelled before the monthly plan starts; it does not compose into a repeating month.

limits.value: 30 GB during the 14-day trial; 30 GB/month on Rookie+ afterwards
registration requires "Entering payment information and billing address"

binding_note: No speed figure is published for the trial.

identity_cost.detail: The provider §1.1b lists "Entering payment information and billing address" as a registration step. §6.1c says the payment provider may "reserve or deduct and reimburse a small amount of money (less than $5.00 US) from the credit card or PayPal account or iDeal account" to verify the customer. A payment instrument is captured before the trial starts.

reliability_note: The trial converts to a paid monthly plan at 7.95 € unless cancelled inside the 14 days; §6.4c stores the registration IP and §6.1d allows immediate blocking where payment data is judged false.
confidence_note: Trial length, volume and the payment gate are each quoted from a vendor page read. A signup completed to the payment step would raise the volume attribution from inferred to measured; it was not executed.

evidence.proved: "Get your 14 day trial with extra security" and "You can try out Usenet risk-free for 14 days with free data volume. During this time, you can cancel at any moment without any hassle."

"USENEXT Rookie+ 30 GB", "0 € During the trial with free download volume", "7.95 € per month" after it, and FAQ "You will only be charged after the trial phase has elapsed, using the payment method you have specified."

§4.2a "The customer may take advantage of the free trial period only once unless the Provider expressly grants the customer an additional free trial period"; §1.1b payment information at registration; §6.1c the sub-$5 card hold; §6.4c the stored registration IP

notes: A second address does not defeat this, because the gate is the payment instrument plus the stored registration IP rather than the network address. Abandonment: if the trial stops being priced at 0 € for a full 14 days, the record becomes paid-only.

extras.repeat_quote: The customer may take advantage of the free trial period only once unless the Provider expressly grants the customer an additional free trial period.
